questions.question: Full-Mark Response Evaluate whether the UK should replace First Past the Post with proportional representation for general elections. <div class="

points.text: A grade 9 response will: describe both systems; present FPTP strengths (simplicity, strong government, constituency link) and weaknesses (disproportionality, wasted votes, small party disadvantage); present PR strengths (fairness, representation) and weaknesses (coalition instability, weak government, broken constituency link); evaluate using 2019 election data and international comparisons; conclude: PR would be fairer and more representative, but FPTP's stability advantage is valued. A hybrid system like AMS might achieve the best balance of fairness, stability and accountability.
